scope: One first-floor exhibition scene; 50 paired place-object requests; five policies; nine reused physical targets.

demos.title: Bedroom cabinet: semantics vs. geometry order
demos.description: The same frozen backbone and start pose. G stops at kitchen cabinets; J reaches the dark cabinet in the bedroom. This illustrates semantic node visitation, not an isolated gain from constructing the skeleton.
demos.alt: B06 task visualization with shared semantic backbone, sampled observation poses, a geometry-order false stop at kitchen cabinets, and joint-policy completion at the bedroom cabinet.

demos.title: Office robot: object match in the wrong room
demos.description: O accepts a robot in the bedroom; J reaches the requested office robot. Both outcomes are externally reviewed against the literal instruction.
demos.alt: O09 task visualization showing object-only search ending at a bedroom robot and joint ranking reaching the office robot.

demos.title: Sofa-side cabinet: an unsupported finish
demos.description: J-V reports completion in an empty transition corridor; J finishes beside the cabinet next to the sofa. This is one mechanism example, not proof that every rejected stop recovers.
demos.alt: L10 task visualization showing a structural-only false stop in a corridor and visually verified completion at the sofa-side cabinet.
